classification: prospective single official attachment GET from captured notice 12590 response
question: Does the single Excel attachment linked by official notice 12590 contain a complete, independently auditable HS300 add/remove list for the adjustment effective 2017-12-11?
reason: The one retained official detail response for notice 12590 states that HS300 changes 24 stocks and links a file titled 调整名单.xlsx. The announcement body itself does not enumerate the full names. A single attachment request is narrowly needed to classify the linked official record; it cannot by itself supply the pre-adjustment 300-member state.
method: Verify the fixed attachment URL and source response hash locally before dispatch.
Persist one-time dispatch intent before making exactly one GET to the fixed official attachment URL. Never retry after dispatch.
Save response bytes, HTTP status, headers, request URL, timestamp, SHA-256, and any parser output as new write-once evidence. Do not fetch other links or notices.

Inspect workbook sheets and count rows/codes for the HS300 adjustment only; record whether it provides full added and removed lists, any stated effective date, and whether it provides a complete 2018-01-02 seed (expected to require a prior state).
prohibited: No second GET, retry, browser navigation, other attachment, notice, listing page, or third-party source.
No panel POST, duplicate, or state transition.
No production or strategy changes, factor-return calculation, alpha scan, or backtest.

decision_rule.delta_supported: A workbook with the full 24 HS300 names entering and leaving, consistently identifying 12 each, supports this event delta only.
decision_rule.seed_supported: The workbook supports the 2018-01-02 seed only if it provides a complete dated member snapshot on or before that day or a complete independently closed chain from a known prior state.
decision_rule.no_go: A delta without the complete pre-adjustment member state, any missing transition, or unresolved exceptional-event effective date keeps PIT reconstruction no-go.

panel.registration_action: no panel request in A10; rely on A9 read-only preflight
